How it works

How ordering works

Our tea is sourced to order, so you only pay once we have confirmed your order.

  1. 01

    Send a request

    Choose your tea and quantity and send the form. No payment, no card details.

  2. 02

    We confirm your order

    We source your tea from Albania and email you the price and the shipping cost for your destination.

  3. 03

    You pay securely

    Happy with the quote? Pay through the secure payment link we send you. That completes your purchase.

  4. 04

    Delivered to your door

    Delivery takes up to 5 days after payment. We email you the tracking and arrival details.

Our collection

Two varieties. One origin.

Çaj Mali can be requested now. Bari i Malit joins the collection later in 2026.

Sourced to order — request now

Northern Alps · 1,200m+

Çaj Mali

Classic Albanian mountain tea

The iconic wild herb of the Albanian highlands. Warm, earthy, naturally sweet with a gentle floral finish. Brewed in Albanian homes for centuries. Naturally caffeine-free.

Earthy warmth Floral Honey notes Caffeine-free

Coming later 2026

Accursed Mountains · 1,500m+

Bari i Malit

Wild alpine herb blend

A blend of wild herbs from the Accursed Mountains — one of Europe's last untouched alpine regions. Fresh, green and slightly minty. Bright and energising without any caffeine.

Fresh & green Minty Herbal Caffeine-free

Albanian Alps · Wild & Untouched

From the mountains of Albania

Albania

Where the tea grows wild

The Albanian Alps are among the most biodiverse mountain ranges in Europe, largely untouched by industry. Çaj Mali has grown here for centuries, gathered by local families the same way it has always been. We go directly to the source to bring it to you.

About Us

Rooted in Albania.
Based in Madrid.

Besa Goods was founded with a simple belief: the best things come from the mountain, unchanged. We source Albanian mountain tea directly from local families who have harvested it at altitudes above 1,200 metres for generations. No middlemen, no additives, no compromises.

Shipping & Returns

Simple & fair.

  • Shipping cost depends on the destination and is confirmed before you pay
  • Delivery up to 5 days after payment, with tracking
  • 14-day return window
  • Contact us to start a return
  • Products must be unopened and in original condition
